notes: DiscoFlate v3.81.1 — fixes a stream that went out mirrored. /api/state reported vcam_mirror as True for an absent key while every other reader defaulted it False, so the panel ticked its own 🪞 Mirror box and passed it into camera.start(): your own Discord tile looked right while everyone else saw the feed backwards. Leave Mirror OFF — Discord mirrors your own tile no matter what, so use the panel's preview to check your look.
